votes.motion: A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Alison Stroud to adopt Resolution #22-43, as amended, a resolution increasing total appropriations within the governmental funds for the fiscal year commencing July 1, 2022 and ending June 30, 2023, and providing for the pursuit of sponsorships and the sale of naming rights for the Alta Canyon Sports Center, and confirming Sandy City's intention to pledge up to $20,000,000 towards the future construction of the Alta Canyon Sports Center and confirming Sandy City's intention to fully fund the replacement of Fire Station 31
